name: Ethinamate
aliases: 1-ethynylcyclohexanol carbamate, 1-Ethynylcyclohexanol carbamate, Aethinyl-cyclohexyl-carbamat, Ethinamatum, Etinamato, Valmid, Valmid®
summary: Ethinamate, marketed as Valmid in the United States and Valamin in Australia, is a central nervous system depressant of the carbamate drug class. It was formerly prescribed as a hypnotic for the short-term treatment of insomnia.5 hours, and a correspondingly brief duration of effect.
